lead: A data-driven step indicator. Each step is complete / current / upcoming / error: completed steps show a check, failed ones a cross, the others their number.

clickable.title: Clickable
clickable.current: Current: `{current}` (click a completed step to go back)

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.step: The list and each step; on a step, `data-status` is its status and `aria-current=step` marks the current one
styling.parts: Clickable area, numbered dot and text area
